description: This file defines the CollationFactory class, which provides collation-aware string functions, collation identifiers, and collation management for Spark SQL, including ICU and UTF8 collations, with detailed handling of collation IDs, locale mappings, and comparison functions.

classes.name: CollationFactory
classes.description: Main class providing collation-aware string functions, collation management, and ID handling.

classes.name: Collation
classes.description: Represents a collation with comparison, sort key, and metadata, supporting ICU and UTF8 collations.

classes.name: CollationIdentifier
classes.description: Identifier for a specific collation, including provider, name, and version.

classes.name: CollationMeta
classes.description: Metadata about a collation, including catalog, schema, language, ICU version, and sensitivity flags.

methods.name: getStringSearch
methods.description: Creates a ICU StringSearch object for pattern matching respecting collation rules.

methods.name: fullyQualifiedNameToId
methods.description: Converts a fully qualified collation name array to its internal ID.

methods.name: collationNameToId
methods.description: Converts a collation name string to its internal ID.

methods.name: resolveFullyQualifiedName
methods.description: Resolves a collation name array to a fully qualified name, assuming default catalog/schema.

methods.name: collationInvalidNameException
methods.description: Constructs an exception for invalid collation names with suggestions.

methods.name: fullyQualifiedName
methods.description: Returns the fully qualified name for a collation ID.

methods.name: isCaseInsensitive
methods.description: Checks if a collation ID corresponds to a case-insensitive collation.

methods.name: isAccentInsensitive
methods.description: Checks if a collation ID corresponds to an accent-insensitive collation.

methods.name: assertValidProvider
methods.description: Validates if a provider string is supported.

methods.name: fetchCollation
methods.description: Retrieves a Collation object for a given collation ID or name.

methods.name: getICULocaleNames
methods.description: Returns the list of ICU locale names supported.

methods.name: applyTrimmingPolicy
methods.description: Applies space trimming policy to a UTF8String based on collation ID.

methods.name: ignoresSpacesInTrimFunctions
methods.description: Determines if spaces should be ignored in trim functions for a given collation.

methods.name: getCollationKey
methods.description: Generates a collation key for a UTF8String based on collation ID.

methods.name: getCollationKeyBytes
methods.description: Returns the byte array of the collation key for a UTF8String.

methods.name: loadCollationMeta
methods.description: Loads collation metadata for a given collation identifier.
